assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits and palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation as a potential etiology for their transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
The patient has a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction.
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
Prolonged cardiac event monitoring is indicated to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances that may not be evident on standard electrocardiography.
CPT 93271 is the service in question.
The diagnosis codes are G45.9, I49.9, and Z86.73.
The claim was denied under Reason Code PR-204.
The denial is based on the member's current benefit plan not covering this specific service.
Coverage determinations are governed by the Summary of Benefits and Coverage.
The patient has the right to file an appeal.
Detailed instructions regarding the appeals process, including required documentation and submission deadlines, are provided in the enclosed Member Handbook.
